tldr: Jupiter in the 1st house: growth becomes personal through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
body:
With Jupiter in the 1st house, this part of you expands through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life. Jupiter describes growth, faith, appetite, opportunity, generosity, and the need for a wider view. In practice, this brings attention to how you enter the room, respond first, take up space, and let the world meet you.

When this placement is supported, you can meet life with more self-trust and less need to explain yourself first. Jupiter can become hope, confidence, perspective, generosity, and a larger sense of possibility.

When it is strained, you may become overly focused on how you are seen, or push your body past what it is trying to tell you. The harder pattern can show up as overextension, excess, overpromising, or assuming more is always better.
gift: hope, confidence, perspective, generosity, and a larger sense of possibility expressed through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
challenge: overextension, excess, overpromising, or assuming more is always better around identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
